items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders despite calf injury.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; sources optimistic no setbacks; McVay called minor.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected in favorable matchup; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets/red-zone share as primary option without Davante Adams.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; was unlikely after limited practice returning from quad strain.
items.why: Quad strain; not full participant; early in return process after missing 3 games.
items.implication: Sit Hall; committee or lead role shifts fully.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for Braelon Allen (not listed) in good matchup vs MIA.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially OUT for Week 7 with ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury; limited practice, ruled out again after missing prior games.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; reduced rushing upside for Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely; Derrick Henry volume secure but less overall scoring.

items.text: Think Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; after strong 124/17/1 as lead back.
items.why: Post-game indication of hamstring issue despite production.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; Tyrone Tracy handcuff elevated.
items.opportunity: If out, full lead role for Tracy; reverse if fine.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no lasting concern post-game.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad) went to locker room but returned to game.
items.implication: Monitor but finished; limited long-term concern short-term.
items.opportunity: Snaps may have been managed; handcuff watch if worsens.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.why: Weekend reports confirm outs for Eagles pass-catchers.
items.implication: Concentrated targets elsewhere in PHI offense; Saquon expected helps run game.
items.opportunity: Boosted routes/targets for remaining WRs/TE Dallas Goedert; possible AJ Brown if available but roster notes NE.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY returning from hamstring.
items.why: Returned to practice; weekend reports optimistic for MNF or relevant game.
items.implication: RB1 workload likely; monitor for any limitations.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play; among multiple activations.
items.why: Activated from injury; full practice indicators.
items.implication: Lead back role post-layoff; start with volume caution.
items.opportunity: High snap share/carries expected vs DET.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown for usage and matchup vs CHI.
items.why: Usage/matchup; Bears secondary soft for yardage.
items.implication: Strong WR start; high target expectation.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft vs DET TE buffet; Lions allow many TE TDs/points.
items.why: DET vulnerable to TEs; 9 TE TDs in 5 games.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren for big workload in friendly matchup vs NO.
items.why: Volume RB; defenses carved by RBs.

items.text: Loves Chuba Hubbard for consistent volume vs TB.
Loves Bucky Irving for volume vs CAR.
Hates Rome Odunze due to shadow coverage vs NE Gonzalez; limited outside production.
items.why: 90% targets outside; Gonzalez shadow; low prior output.

items.text: Hates Josh Downs in tough spot @ MIN.
Hates Josh Jacobs post-layoff workload questions vs DET.
items.why: Rust after long absence; role uncertainty.
items.conflict: ETR/Schefter confirm IN/expected play; usage may still be high.
